comment: [SOURCE] Transcribed from PAGE 1 of the source PDF, 'Daily Checklist for GAYK/DOYLE Piledrivers'
(GAYK North America, doc 240916). All 13 source bullets are present, in source order. PAGE 2 of
the same PDF is a separate 'Weekly Checklist and Maintenance' ('Must be done in addition to the
daily checklist') and is deliberately NOT part of this pre-operation form — a weekly maintenance
duty is not a pre-op inspection, and folding it in here would make operators attest weekly
greasing every shift. It ships instead as a checklist-library template, seeded by migration
0062_gayk_weekly_maintenance_checklist.sql (#47).
Corroborating provenance for the duty list: GAYK_NA_Ram_Training_Program_Waiver_and_Checklist.pdf
topic 1, 'Pre-Start-Up Walk Around and Fluid Levels'.
[SCALE] The source uses bare completion checkboxes with NO named response states, so there is no
source vocabulary to transcribe. This form therefore adopts the equipment-preinspection parent's
established ['OK','NO','N/A'] scale (identical to equipment-telehandler-v1) rather than inventing
a done/not-done scale: an inspection whose only expressible answer is 'I did it' cannot record a
DEFECT, which is the point of a pre-op inspection. 'NO' therefore means 'checked, problem found'.
[ADDED FIELDS — machine identity] The source page has no header block at all; it identifies the
machine nowhere and the operator only at the bottom ('Print: ___ Sign: ___ Date: ___'). A fleet
inspection record that cannot say WHICH piledriver was inspected is not auditable, so a single
'Unit No.' header field is added, matching the parent convention (equipment-skid-steer-v1 'UNIT',
equipment-telehandler-v1 'unit_no'). Make/model is not added — it is fixed by the variant itself.
The source's Print/Sign move to the Sign-off section; its Date rides the work_date envelope.
[PER-ITEM COMMENTS] FIVE source bullets carry a prose write-in line — 'Note any damage:', 'Note
level and condition:' (twice), 'Note level:' and 'Note fault codes:' — and exactly those five set
comment:true. The remaining seven set no comment, so the group default (comment_per_item:false)
applies. A SIXTH bullet has a write-in that is a NUMBER, not prose ('Hours: ___'), and is captured
as kind:'numeric' instead — the skid-steer precedent for 'HOURS ON MACHINE'. The final bullet
('Please note any issues that occurred while operating machine') is a full-width free-text block on
the source, so it is a freeform SECTION, not an item.
[LEGAL FLOOR] The closing lock/tag-out static_text is NOT on the source PDF. It is the
equipment-preinspection PARENT requirement (safety_portal/required-content.json:
'ALWAYS lock/tag-out unsafe equipment' plus required_signature_inputs_min 1), carried
byte-identically from equipment-skid-steer-v1 and equipment-telehandler-v1.
[TRANSCRIPTION NORMALIZATIONS] Two punctuation fixes only, per forms/README.md ('obvious source
typos are noted but the digital label is corrected'): source 'condition fill if required' gains a
comma; source '227ft-lbs' gains the missing space. No torque value, fluid spec or instruction was
altered — 150Nm/111 ft-lbs, 308Nm/227 ft-lbs, 'clean clear diesel (no red diesel!)', 'GAYK
approved coolant' and the Kajo hammer-paste pump schedule are verbatim.

items.label: Walk around machine checking for obstructions in or around and damage to machine — note any damage
Check engine oil for level and condition — note level and condition
Check coolant level and condition, fill if required with GAYK approved coolant — note level
Check fuel level and fill if required with clean clear diesel (no red diesel!)
Check hydraulic oil for level and condition — note level and condition
Check hammer collar bolts and tighten to 150Nm/111 ft-lbs. if necessary
Check head guide bolts and tighten to 308Nm/227 ft-lbs. if necessary
Check operation of work lights and beacon light
Turn key to on position and check hour meter and note the hours for maintenance — Hours
Start machine, raise mast and compress the head to add Kajo hammer paste — two pumps in the AM, two pumps after lunch
Check for faults — note fault codes

sections.label: Please note any issues that occurred while operating machine

sections.text: Report any problems found to your supervisor/employer. ALWAYS lock/tag-out unsafe equipment.
